Southern cooking on Grant Avenue

2 Peaches cooks Southern food the Atlanta way: catfish fried crisp, grits stirred slow, and peach cobbler waiting at the end.

Eat in, take it to go, or call ahead and we'll have it ready. We cater too: weddings, baby shower brunches and events on Fort Riley. Ask us about catering.
